Homestead: You've come prepared to settle down. Start with a Homestead Kit, bundled for travel. Drop it wherever you want to build your homestead, then use Place to unpack a cabin kit, two rain cistern kits, and a stockpile of building materials (30 planks, 30 mud bricks, 50 stones, 20 heavy stones, 15 tree logs, 20 clay, 10 rope, 20 metal nuggets) all at once — then Place each kit to raise it. Everything can only be placed once.
